item.title: To criticize an American-led war, an American pope turns to allies
item.summary: A split-screen response shows how Pope Leo is navigating a minefield as the Trump administration projects American nativism at home and deadly force overseas.

item.title: Trump says U.S. struck Kharg Island, core of Iran’s oil economy
item.summary: The strikes destroyed more than 90 military targets, including missile facilities, but preserved oil infrastructure, U.S. Central Command said Saturday.

item.title: Trump urged uprising, but as bombs fall, Iranians are ‘too scared to move’
item.summary: Some Iranians living in Dubai say their families celebrated the death of the supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, but the war could leave Iran in a worse situation than before.

item.title: How Trump suspending sanctions on Russian oil helps Putin’s war effort
item.summary: The Kremlin hopes the Trump administration’s move to contain oil prices sent soaring by the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran will lead to further relief.

item.title: Deportees sent by Trump to Salvadoran prison are still stuck a year later
item.summary: Little is known about the status or whereabouts of the Salvadorans deported by President Donald Trump to CECOT, an infamous megaprison.

item.title: They came to build China’s EV future. Investigators found conditions akin to ‘slavery.’
item.summary: Few Chinese laborers have spoken out about the abuses they allegedly suffered while toiling abroad. Until now.

item.title: Kids in hospital help penguins woo mates with painted pebbles
item.summary: “I always get really emotional when the pebbles go in,” said Rebecca Parr, who works for the Royal Zoological Society of Scotland.
